about: Inputs from different kinds of project, for the thesis call. Each is a meeting transcript that creates one project (its change set fixed here, so only the thesis is the model's), in a workspace of the corpus plus the documents in docs/, whose figures are in the graph. expect: thesis (true when the input gives a reason to expect a countable improvement), use (figures the documents state that a sound thesis would draw on: how many it finds is reported), wrong (figures that, found for a formula number, mean the number was misread).
